findings.title: Restored SessionContext exposes internal history_base source cut in product DTO
findings.observation: The restored eligibility of every non-internal AnalysisEvent includes SessionContext. CodexEventAdapter::adapt_session copies the typed HistoryBaseRef into payload.history_base (mod.rs:216). HistoryBaseRef contains parent_rollout_id, end_ordinal_exclusive and end_byte_offset (source/lineage.rs:21). productEventFact removes only payload.metadata (importer:1557-1568), retaining this schema-defined source locator/read cut. CodexHistoryProductProvider projectItems/projectValue serializes the object unchanged. A read-only exact-helper→actual-Provider in-memory fixture confirmed history.items[].payloadJson.eventFacts[0].payload.history_base contains all three fields while complete=true.
findings.trigger: A validated child rollout SessionContext with a non-null history_base; the current real target used for R3 is a root and does not exercise this optional field.
findings.impact: Internal rollout identity and source read boundaries cross the canonical product/App DTO boundary, violating product metadata isolation; Diagnostic exclusion alone does not make a non-diagnostic event payload entirely business data.
requirements: docs/codex/codex-history-product-contract.md §3.2: source locator, read cursor and internal collection/recovery metadata must remain in staging/checkpoints, outside ConversationHistory/App DTO/Gateway payload
Rust analyzer data contract §3: history_items/AnalysisEvent is Rust→Node analysis output, not an App or stage-5 product DTO
Adopted S2 scope: preserve business facts while isolating internal analyzer/source metadata by schema; no arbitrary business-key filtering
findings.recommendation: At canonical product construction, exclude the known SessionContext.history_base source-evidence field by event schema while retaining cwd/model_provider/source/session business facts and internal staging evidence. Do not recursively remove arbitrary history_base keys in tool/business payloads or add Gateway key-name filtering. Add a child SessionContext positive/negative importer→Store/provider regression with a non-null HistoryBaseRef.

prior_findings_assessment.observation: Exact current helper over the frozen real 270-event staging batch yields 98 rows (1 SessionContext, 3 TurnStarted, 3 user, 10 assistant, 39 tool, 21 RateLimitUpdated, 21 UsageUpdated), preserving cwd E:\coding\LawAgent and all 21 rate-limit facts while excluding 130 Diagnostic rows. Fresh real-Rust product flow passes positive cwd/model_provider and primary_used_percent/window assertions. No current real-host publication proof is claimed.

Current filter excludes Diagnostic/ParseGap/UnknownEvent by event type and removes those records from mixed-key eventFacts. Same-name legitimate diagnostic/code/sourcePath/requestId fields are retained. Staging unchanged. This is not full approval of product metadata isolation due R5.

Screenshot and stable-item evidence are byte-identical to execution 585 and previous review 128; no new device run occurred on the R4 subject. Prior concrete command visibility plus product page/ACK/cache correlation remains its original historical observation, preserving healthy IPC authority.
